Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0097, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0098, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0099 1. Lemma 3.18\group harmonic-map-flow

If $f:(\M ^n,g)\to (\N ^n,h)$ is a diffeomorphism, then its harmonic map Laplacian satisfies \[ (\Delta _{g,h}f)^\gamma (x) =\bigl[(f^{-1})^*g\bigr]^{\alpha \beta } \left(-\Gamma \bigl((f^{-1})^*g\bigr)^\gamma _{\alpha \beta }+\Gamma (h)^\gamma _{\alpha \beta }\right)\! (f(x)). \]

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0099 \sketch Compute the Christoffel symbols of a pullback metric, then rewrite the harmonic map Laplacian in terms of those symbols by substituting $\varphi =f$ and $\kappa =(f^{-1})^*g$.

□
